detail_profile.scope: Visible southwest/southeast crown, selected podium facades, southwest estimated stairs and flat planting coverage; hidden faces, exact slopes and railings unresolved
detail_profile.observations: Two crown faces registered by roof corners, skylight, western planted terraces and eastern teaching block positions in the official 2023 aerial. Southwest diagonal motif corroborated by tour-bg3 close photograph. The 2023 aerial resolves face orientation absent from the earlier close view alone. Official gallery images 1 and 15 show continuous pale fascia, curved middle glazing and visible lower glazing; OSM simplifies podium curves as straight segments. Campus panorama down-face, the 2023 aerial and official gallery exteriors show southwest stairs with intermediate planting and a western planted roof. RLP independent Phase 1 aerial confirms the west garden roof and its white folded edge lines.
detail_profile.unresolved: Other crown faces, exact podium/stair shape, measured riser count and slope, western planted roof slope, rails, glass transmission, interiors, actual terrain/height, full roof equipment and construction changes.
detail_profile.dimension_status: Source-part top 15.2 m and adjacent podium 7.6 m are level-derived estimates; relative photo traces, beam width, frame depth, mullion spacing and color are unmeasured. Middle podium has a photo-estimated 9 m tangent fillet at the source corner, not a surveyed curvature; existing 3.8 m floor conversions retained. Southwest stairs: 24 display risers, 8 planting bands and 32 m run within the source platform are estimates; west roof planting retains the mapped flat top pending slope evidence. Roof-edge layout uses uncalibrated four-corner correspondence; wall height and thickness are display estimates.
detail_profile.description_zh: 顶部圆形天窗、西南斜撑、曲面裙楼与玻璃沿用已登记影像。补入西南侧两段室外台阶、中间平台、分段种植带和西侧屋顶绿化；级数、尺度与颜色为展示估算，西侧真实坡面尚未重建。

detail_profile.observations: The lower central GALLERY volume between the two long cultural wings faces the lake. Public lake-level and aerial photographs show a glazed face, pale vertical fins, dark transoms and a warm panel at its southwest end. Selected edge points toward the lake. The northeastern long wing inner lake face is manually registered to way/1475182845 edge 5 using the wing turn, central GALLERY and CTV context. Nine narrow vertical regions are visible in the upper pale band, the last brown. Actual openings and physical material remain unresolved. A 2023 official article photograph shows two lower rows of white vertical screen bars and one crossed pair adjacent to GALLERY. Manual extraction selects 24 vertical bars, two diagonals and three horizontal borders. The last upper strip appears gray-blue in this photograph versus brown in the aerial; physical material and capture dates remain unresolved. The photo shows two recessed galleries behind the screen. Display recess is 1.5m, with two visible pale posts and floor/front bands; real depth, structural role, rear openings and ground-level passages remain unresolved. Southwest wing lake face: 21 manually selected pale vertical members and five edge segments; rear openings unresolved.
